column2: Short title
Quarterly revenue summary
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
A concise sentence should remain on one measured line.
Revenue increased across every region during the quarter.
Customer retention improved while acquisition costs remained stable.
The project team completed the migration before the scheduled deadline.
Design systems make repeated authoring choices predictable and reviewable.
Reliable automation reports what it measured and names what remains unproven.
The workbook includes regional revenue, product mix, and year over year growth.
Agents should receive stable selectors, deterministic output, and useful diagnostics.
Presentation layouts need enough room for readable text and balanced whitespace.
A trustworthy estimator uses the actual advance width of every printable character.
Bold headings are slightly wider than body copy and must be measured independently.
Narrow letters like i and l consume less space than wide letters like W and M.
Numbers 1234567890 and punctuation can materially change the width of a report label.
Forecast accuracy improved after the planning model incorporated seasonal demand.
Operational excellence depends on small repeatable checks at every mutation boundary.
The sales organization expanded coverage without increasing average response time.
Clear ownership and explicit evidence keep parallel engineering work from colliding.
This paragraph contains enough words to wrap across several lines in a four inch box while remaining easy to inspect.
The release candidate passed structural validation, schema validation, and a visual render inspection on Linux.
Every generated artifact should carry a readback command and the strongest proof command available in the environment.
When a platform font is unavailable the debug report names the calibrated substitute instead of pretending the native font was measured.
Deterministic numeric tables make the layout calculation portable across developer laptops, CI runners, and headless agents.
A body paragraph can include currency values such as USD 12,450.75 and percentages such as 18.4 percent without clipping.
The executive summary explains the decision, the supporting evidence, the material risk, and the recommended next action.
Good defaults reduce command count because the user does not need to repair avoidable spacing, color, or typography problems.
The estimator respects paragraph indentation so bullets do not silently consume the horizontal space intended for their text.
Line spacing contributes to vertical overflow even when the same words occupy an identical number of wrapped lines.
A layout warning is actionable when it identifies the shape, reports the available bounds, and suggests a concrete correction.
The measurement surface is read only and emits JSON so another agent can compare its estimate with a rendered presentation.
Font metrics are factual numeric observations extracted from font tables; this repository does not redistribute the fonts themselves.
The fallback profile covers unknown families conservatively and remains visible in the result for honest debugging.
Wide uppercase sequences such as WWW MMM QQQ occupy more room than narrow sequences such as iii lll ttt.
Mixed case labels like Gross Margin, Net Revenue, and Operating Expense appear throughout financial presentations.
A long category label may need rotation on a chart while an ordinary body paragraph should wrap naturally within its placeholder.
The visual calibration corpus contains fifty independent paragraphs and states that denominator in every failure report.
The current estimate is acceptable when each rendered paragraph differs by no more than one visual line from LibreOffice.
Regression tests pin representative character advances, fallback selection, bold behavior, wrapping, height, and Excel column width.
Simple data is easier to audit than compressed generated source because a reviewer can inspect every stored number and mapping.
Text measurement is an estimate rather than a full shaping engine, so complex scripts and ligatures remain an explicit limitation.
The implementation handles explicit newlines, spaces, tabs, long tokens, bullet indents, and ordinary Unicode fallback widths.
Autofit uses the same font table as slide overflow checks so both features agree about the width of identical text.
The exact shape bounds can come from the slide, its layout, or its master, and the debug output preserves that provenance.
A small amount of cell padding is added after measuring the displayed value because spreadsheet columns are not bare text boxes.
Percentage, currency, date, and scientific number formats reserve additional width for glyphs introduced by formatting.
Unknown font families resolve to a documented Noto Sans profile rather than depending on whatever fontconfig happens to choose.
The measured source family is returned beside the requested family so substitutions are observable in automated diagnostics.
This final calibration paragraph confirms that the complete fifty paragraph corpus renders, extracts, and compares deterministically.
